comprehensive experiments on existing reward
model benchmarks and inference time best-of-n
searches on real-world downstream tasks. RE-
WARDAGENT significantly outperforms vanilla
reward models, demonstrating its effectiveness.
We further construct training preference pairs
using REWARDAGENT and train an LLM with
the DPO objective, achieving superior perfor-
mance on various NLP benchmarks compared
to conventional reward models. Our codes are
publicly released to facilitate further research1.
